test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: L, P, R, V, X, Y, and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. R sits to the immediate right of V. Only three people sit between R and Z when counted from the left of R. Only three people sit between V and P. X sits to the immediate right of Y. How many people sit between L and Y, when counted from the left of Y?
solution:
**Given: **L, P, R, V, X, Y, and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. R sits to the immediate right of V. Only three people sit between R and Z when counted from the left of R. 

1) R sits to the immediate right of V. 

2) Only three people sit between R and Z when counted from the left of R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c67436079676fc07fc2f519d6360938f59ef4da1daf456b08aa7c6b95ba49c9.png] 

3) Only three people sit between V and P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da1a7035ae8c3a79b369b2e333af15a8d34ff1acb7b0498eb1c62c7f95df38d1.png] 

4) X sits to the immediate right of Y.

After positioning X and Y only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/801f54033cbcc02b8fc3e5c9a37d98557d2eee9ecf5a3d86c4df4d0727bb2d26.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, two people sit between L and Y, when counted from the left of Y.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
